content:
This week, Apple added a batch of new products to its Certified Refurbished Store, including brand-new M5 MacBook Pro models, Studio Display XDR, high-end M5 MacBook Air configurations, and more.

Just a reminder: Apple's Certified Refurbished Store is a great way to save money, with discounts of up to 15%, and purchases are made directly from Apple's official website, so you can buy with confidence.

Here's how Apple describes its refurbished store:

  • Quality products at attractive prices
  • Undergoes a rigorous refurbishment process before being sold
  • Comes with Apple's one-year limited warranty
  • Covered by Apple's 14-day return policy
  • AppleCare service plans available for purchase
  • Engraving and gift wrapping services are not available for refurbished products

One thing to note: we track every new addition and clearance item in the Apple Certified Refurbished Store — stock goes fast. One of the goals of this article is to let you know what's available, so you can act quickly before products sell out.

What's new this week at the Apple Refurbished Store?

New Mac computers

Apple has expanded the range of Mac configurations available in its refurbished store. These models were first released by Apple earlier this year, and more stock has been added this week.

The standout is the 14-inch M5 MacBook Pro with 512GB of storage, priced at $1,439. Apple no longer sells this configuration, and the cheapest M5 model now starts at $1,999 with 1TB of storage.

  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air, with 4TB of storage and 24GB of memory — Midnight: $2,969 (originally $3,499)
  • 14-inch M5 MacBook Pro, with 512GB of storage and 16GB of memory — Space Black: $1,439
  • 14-inch M5 MacBook Pro, with nano-texture display, 2TB of storage and 24GB of memory — Space Black: $2,419 (originally $2,849)
  • 16-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro, with 4TB of storage and 24GB of memory — Silver: $3,819 (originally $4,499)

Apple TV 4K

The Apple TV 4K has always been a hot item at the Apple Certified Refurbished Store, and it's back in stock this week.

  • Apple TV 4K 64GB (3rd generation) Wi-Fi: $169 (originally $199)
  • Apple TV 4K 128GB (3rd generation) Wi-Fi + Ethernet: $209 (originally $249)

Studio Display

  • Refurbished Studio Display XDR — Standard glass — VESA mount adapter: $2,459 (originally $2,899)
  • Refurbished Studio Display XDR — Nano-texture glass — VESA mount adapter: $2,719 (originally $3,199)
  • Refurbished Studio Display XDR — Standard glass — Tilt- and height-adjustable stand: $2,799 (originally $3,299)
  • Refurbished Studio Display XDR — Nano-texture glass — Tilt- and height-adjustable stand: $3,059 (originally $3,599)

More recommendations

Finally, Apple also added several new Apple Watch configurations and more to the refurbished store this week:

  • Apple Watch SE 3 GPS + Cellular, 40mm Starlight: $249 (originally $299)
  • Apple Watch SE GPS + Cellular, 44mm Silver: $239 (originally $279)
  • Apple Watch SE 3 GPS + Cellular, 44mm Midnight: $279 (originally $329)
  • iPhone 16 Pro 512GB — Desert Titanium (unlocked): $1,019 (originally $1,199)

You can visit 9to5Toys to keep up with all the Apple deals throughout the week.
